title: arm the E0091 letter-cluster guardrail: adjudicate label schemes, then spec-review the DESIGN coinage cleanup, then land the register clean

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
GOAL: land .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml armed for MDATRON-E0091 (letter-cluster prohibition) — mechanizing the 'no coined labels' discipline from convention grade to CI-backed. Parent: #822 F2 (arming proven; families.vocabulary flips active; but 80-instance/12-scheme coinage debt in the DESIGN docs blocks landing since pre-commit mdatron verify would fail).

STEP 1 — adjudicate the 12 schemes (per scheme: allow a legit/registered scheme, or rewrite an ad-hoc coinage):
- ALLOW (legit tech / false positive): SHA-<n> (SHA-256), OSC-<n> (OSC-8 terminal escape), A-Z<n> (regex char-class fragment).
- BARE CODE REFS (governance call — allow bare '^[EWL][0-9]{4}$', or require VSDD-/MDATRON- prefixes): E-code refs x14 (E0099...), W-code refs x7 (W0191...), L-code ref x1 (L0050).
- ADJUDICATE (register the scheme in allow, OR rewrite as coinage): finding-mode F-number x25 (the canonical prohibited pattern), requirement R-number x19, mitigation MITIG-F-number x4, milestone/mode M-number x3, STEP-number x3, domain-finding SO-F-number x1.

STEP 2 — rewrite the adjudicated coinages in DESIGN-METHODOLOGY.md / DESIGN-SCHEMA.md / DESIGN-VERIFICATION.md via the SPEC-REVIEW LOOP (owned: composition + cold review; operator approval is the exit gate, not a substitute). Not a solo sweep.

STEP 3 — author .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml with the adjudicated label_schemes.allow; mdatron verify clean; commit (pre-commit passes). Optional further stage: arm E0090 (bold-term register) by porting templates/registry/vocabulary.yaml into the terms: schema.

LANDING CRITERIA: governed docs E0091-clean + register committed + families.vocabulary active. Note the irony worth recording: the contract that defines the no-coined-labels discipline currently violates it at scale.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: DONE (core) — E0091 ARMED over the enduring corpus; PR #5 open, CI GREEN (verify 32s + test 49s; families.vocabulary active). The 'no coined labels' discipline is now a CI-backed check over the artifacts the harness ships (domain prompts, supplements, registry data sets) — not agent vigilance (which this session proved unreliable). Register: .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml; allows VSDD/MDATRON code namespaces + genuine tech terms (H1-6, OSC-8, JSON5); rewrote the enduring coinages ('R79 F3 anti-pattern', 'milestone N-1', 'milestones M1..MN') to plain descriptors. DELIBERATELY OUT OF SCOPE: the transitional prose (methodology.md, DESIGN-*.md) — superseded/stop-gap, retires as the harness subsumes the methodology; its ~80-cluster debt retires with it (doc-sunset #821). Remaining: merge PR #5 + branch protection to make it a hard block.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: CLOSED — E0091 armed and proven (the .mdatron/vocabulary.yaml register is live; the family fires — it caught ~60 REQ-handle findings in the #840 cycle, fixed by descriptive names per operator ruling, and E0093 deprecated-coinage rides beside it). The coinage-debt docs (DESIGN-METHODOLOGY/-SCHEMA/-VERIFICATION) were deleted whole in the #826 sunset, retiring the 80-instance debt with them. The discipline sits at CI-backed grade on the governed corpus.
